raw.rationale: Varenicline is a high-affinity nicotinic acetylcholine receptor partial agonist with no known broad cytotoxic or antiproliferative activity at 2.5 µM, and PRISM single-concentration screens of approved non-oncology drugs rarely show lineage-selective killing; nAChR expression in lung and CNS lineages is insufficient to produce a selective viability effect. Thus probabilities are near the low end of the stated base rate for all lineages.
